Name: GRAPHICS_CONFIG_CS_LIGHTING_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Determines the parameters of each lighting quality level.

Fields.Name: Local Light: Distance Factor
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the effective distance of local lights. Smaller values make them disappear at shorter distances.

Fields.Name: Local Light: Enable Shadows
Fields.Description: If ON, local lights can cast shadows.

Fields.Name: Local Light: Enable Forward Pass Lighting
Fields.Description: If ON, forward pass lighting is used. this means each object is drawn one by one. Whereas deferred rendering means all information for each object is rendered into multiple buffers first.

Fields.Name: Local Light: Max Shadow Spec Level
Fields.Description: Maximum spec level of local lights that are given shadows. The larger the value, the more light sources cast shadows.
